text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"—Next up, Japanese proverbs!
Repeat after me!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
âRepeat after me!
Even grains of chili powder can make a volcano!

text_block_list.name: International Students
text_block_list.text: C-Chili powder... a-also piles up... into a volcano...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, with such a tiny canto,
I can't hear the melodia, you know?
Ride upon our musica and let it resound!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Earth
text_block_list.text: Volcaaanooo~~♪♪
choice_data_list: (...All the international students have frozen up...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and Sounds of Earth are singing proverbs in front of international exchange students.
As for how it came to this—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! A passionate Japanese lecture
for exchange students?

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer
text_block_list.text:
Some exchange students shy away because of the language barrier...
I feel what they need right now is simply the desire to connect.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer
text_block_list.text: So, I want you two—Taiki-san as a fellow international student, and Earth-san who expresses her feelings through music—to lead everyone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
Leave everything to me—you're on board a big ship now!

text_block_list.name: Serious Exchange Student Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Um... Taiki-san and Earth-san's words are all jumbled up, aren't they...?
Can they really understand each other like that...?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, of course!
We're always like this!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "As long as you have the desire to connect, people will get the message even if you mess up a teeny bit!"

text_block_list.name: International Students
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's wrong... really?"
"If you don't say it accurately, they won't understand, right..."
"It'd just confuse the other person too..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear.
It seems my amori's ritmo is a bit out of sync.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In that case—Suoniamo!
How about holding a concerto of words?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees!
Passion is best experienced live at a concert!
From here on, it's an extracurricular lesson!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
――Hey. There's Suzuka and the others over there.
Shall we get our "session" started right away?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Trainer, please take care of supporting the international exchange students!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, everyo~ne!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today is absolute-ly perfect outdoor weather!
My heart is totally jumping for joy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah...—Did you mean to say
"perfect weather for an outing"?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're right. I definitely feel like going for a run a bit farther out today.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I feel the vivace musica too! I want to rush forth abbandono and engrave a brand-new melodia!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes! Lady Shiraoki has spoken! On a day like this, 'Good fortune comes from following your heart and setting out on a journey!'

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I know Japanese proverbs!
A good day trip feels like a dream!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. Neo Universe also... "JEMs"... "spacewalking."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Earth! Exciting music, please!
Even if it's just our hearts, let's go on a thrilling trip~♪

text_block_list.name: International Students
text_block_list.text:
"...What is this? The words are so weird..."
"Yeah. Like, I don't really get it, but I do?"
"The other girl looks like she's having fun too... I wonder why?"
choice_data_list: Um... "Why don't we ask them directly?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? What Taiki and the others are saying?
Well, yes. I can pretty much get the gist of it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
Even if the words are... "EXDFF"...
I will... "interpret" on "this end."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"You two are just so straightforward!
Your feelings come through loud and clear, which makes it
so easy for me to take them in without worry~!"

text_block_list.name: Serious Exchange Student Umamusume
text_block_list.text: “Accept... her feelings...”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Both musica and words—
as long as there is a heart willing to receive them,
they will surely blend into armonia!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"The most important thing—
is the passion to convey your feelings!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"When I first came to Japan, I kept misspeaking all the time...
I almost got discouraged thinking, 'Japanese is way too hard!'"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"But still, once I focused on putting my heart into what I wanted to say, ev~eryone started smiling!
It made me want to talk even mo~re!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine if your words aren't completely precise!
They're just meant to pour your feelings right out!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Freezing up because you're trying to say
the perfect thing is the biggest waste of all, right?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. The rhythm of my amores
has started dancing so lightly!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, why don't we turn this into a tea party?
First off, let's all have fun
‘expressing our feelings’!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Looks like today's musica left behind a proper armonia!
Everyone's expressions were so animato!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm so glad our passion
got through to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
By talking to so many girls...
I want their academy life—
to become even more happy, YES!
choice_data_list: I really love how positive both of you are!
I really love how positive both of you are!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
By talking to so many girls...
I want their academy life—
to become even more happy, YES!
choice_data_list: I really love how positive both of you are!
I really love how positive both of you are!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Trainer, you can
"convey" your feelings much, much more too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Feelings are power!
Because passion is energy, after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees! Great success!
My passion exploded in a biiiig way!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us play one final melodia!
To celebrate the ritmo that resonated between us today—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's danciiing!
Whoo-hoooo!!!!
